title: Chu–Han Contention
synopsis: The Han Dynasty was one of the most powerful and prosperous periods of Chinese history, but its birth was not easy.

fullText.simplified:
楚汉相争

    为什么中国大多数人都是“汉族”？
    在秦朝以前，中国这块土地上只有许多的小国，每个小国自力更生，因此没有统一的民族。后来，虽然秦朝把这些小国都合并了，但秦朝只存在了十四年，来自全国各地的人们还没有觉得自己是同一个民族，秦朝就已经灭亡了。
    然后到了汉朝。汉朝建立后，国家变得强盛起来，一直延续了四百多年。渐渐地，大家就都认为自己是“汉人”，都认为自己是同一个民族——“汉族”了。到了今天，“汉族”的人口已经有十二亿之多了。
    这么厉害的汉朝，它的诞生可不是一件顺利的事。
    在秦朝末年，皇帝逼着老百姓去当兵，去给他修房子、修长城，为此饿死、累死了很多人，所以到处都有人造反起义，想自己做皇帝。那些起义的人，为了让自己的身份更合理，有的人说：“做皇帝、做将军的人难道是上天选中的吗？他们能当皇帝、将军，我也可以试试”；有的人说：“我的妈妈梦见白龙，生下了我，我是上天选中的皇帝”；还有的人说：“我的祖先是皇帝，我身份高贵”……
    想做皇帝的人很多，但是皇帝的位置只有一个。所以这些人约好：“谁先抵达皇帝的家——关中，谁就能做下一个皇帝！”这些人中，最有名的两个人就是项羽和刘邦。
    项羽是个身份高贵的年轻人，他特别会打仗。他的支持者非常多。他唯一的缺点是：固执。
    刘邦虽然总说自己是白龙的孩子，可他没有项羽这么有真材实料。刘邦的家境普普通通，人也已经四十多岁了。他唯一的优点是：听话。
    项羽和刘邦同时往关中攻打。按照他们的约定，谁先攻打下关中，谁就是下一个皇帝。可惜的是，项羽走得不太顺利，路上遇到了不少秦兵。他不停地打啊、打啊，回头一看，刘邦已经进了关中。
    项羽急了，他决定不管什么约定了，杀了刘邦，自己不就能当皇帝了吗？项羽进到关中后，在朋友、老师的指点下，在城外“鸿门”这个地方安排好了一个宴会，准备请刘邦来吃饭，然后在那里杀了他。
    项羽的人马有四十多万，刘邦的人马只有十几万。经过手下的分析，刘邦从胜利的兴奋中清醒过来，他也明白了事态严峻：一不小心，恐怕自己就会死在项羽的刀下。于是，他事先跟项羽的叔叔求情，装作很可怜的样子，说：“我进了关中，也是等着项羽，想帮你们管好这些人呢！我没有想当皇帝，但项羽却想杀我。请您帮我求求情，让项羽不要杀我。”
    刘邦的办法很有用，项羽的叔叔听了刘邦的话，认为刘邦是个好人，帮他劝说了项羽。
    到了“鸿门宴”那天，刘邦硬着头皮应邀前来，还郑重地向项羽道歉。这让项羽觉得自己误会了刘邦，就开始犹豫要不要杀刘邦。
    项羽的老师见多识广，他敏锐地发觉刘邦是在伪装，况且他不想给项羽留下什么隐患，所以坚持要杀掉刘邦。他请了一个人表演舞剑，企图假装“不小心”，一剑杀了刘邦。项羽却迟疑了，他想：“倘若自己杀错了好人，势必会影响自己的名声、信誉。”
    这时，项羽的叔叔不想刘邦死，他也起来舞剑，想方设法保护了刘邦，因此项羽的老师就没有机会杀人了。
    过了一会儿，刘邦借口“上厕所”，从后门溜走，动身回自己的领地了。他从这次致命的宴会中成功逃脱，也争取到了继续发展势力的机会。
    项羽的老师对此非常恼火，大骂项羽：“这小子，真不该和他一起做事！我敢说，最后当上皇帝的一定是刘邦，我们都会死在他手里！”
    到底项羽老师的预言有没有成真呢？请听下回分解。
    “鸿门宴”这个故事非常有名。现在，我们仍旧会把这种危险的、不怀好意的邀请称为“鸿门宴”。譬如说：我和他一直都是竞争对手，今天他突然要请我吃饭，我看这一定是“鸿门宴”！

楚漢相爭

    為什麼中國大多數人都是“漢族”？
    在秦朝以前，中國這塊土地上只有許多的小國，每個小國自力更生，因此沒有統一的民族。後來，雖然秦朝把這些小國都合併了，但秦朝只存在了十四年，來自全國各地的人們還沒有覺得自己是同一個民族，秦朝就已經滅亡了。
    然後到了漢朝。漢朝建立後，國家變得強盛起來，一直延續了四百多年。漸漸地，大家就都認為自己是“漢人”，都認為自己是同一個民族——“漢族”了。到了今天，“漢族”的人口已經有十二億之多了。
    這麼厲害的漢朝，它的誕生可不是一件順利的事。
    在秦朝末年，皇帝逼著老百姓去當兵，去給他修房子、修長城，為此餓死、累死了很多人，所以到處都有人造反起義，想自己做皇帝。那些起義的人，為了讓自己的身份更合理，有的人說：“做皇帝、做將軍的人難道是上天選中的嗎？他們能當皇帝、將軍，我也可以試試”；有的人說：“我的媽媽夢見白龍，生下了我，我是上天選中的皇帝”；還有的人說：“我的祖先是皇帝，我身份高貴”……
    想做皇帝的人很多，但是皇帝的位置只有一個。所以這些人約好：“誰先抵達皇帝的家——關中，誰就能做下一個皇帝！”這些人中，最有名的兩個人就是項羽和劉邦。
    項羽是個身份高貴的年輕人，他特別會打仗。他的支持者非常多。他唯一的缺點是：固執。
    劉邦雖然總說自己是白龍的孩子，可他沒有項羽這麼有真材實料。劉邦的家境普普通通，人也已經四十多歲了。他唯一的優點是：聽話。
    項羽和劉邦同時往關中攻打。按照他們的約定，誰先攻打下關中，誰就是下一個皇帝。可惜的是，項羽走得不太順利，路上遇到了不少秦兵。他不停地打啊、打啊，回頭一看，劉邦已經進了關中。
    項羽急了，他決定不管什麼約定了，殺了劉邦，自己不就能當皇帝了嗎？項羽進到關中後，在朋友、老師的指點下，在城外“鴻門”這個地方安排好了一個宴會，準備請劉邦來吃飯，然後在那裡殺了他。
    項羽的人馬有四十多萬，劉邦的人馬只有十幾萬。經過手下的分析，劉邦從勝利的興奮中清醒過來，他也明白了事態嚴峻：一不小心，恐怕自己就會死在項羽的刀下。於是，他事先跟項羽的叔叔求情，裝作很可憐的樣子，說：“我進了關中，也是等著項羽，想幫你們管好這些人呢！我沒有想當皇帝，但項羽卻想殺我。請您幫我求求情，讓項羽不要殺我。”
    劉邦的辦法很有用，項羽的叔叔聽了劉邦的話，認為劉邦是個好人，幫他勸說了項羽。
    到了“鴻門宴”那天，劉邦硬著頭皮應邀前來，還鄭重地向項羽道歉。這讓項羽覺得自己誤會了劉邦，就開始猶豫要不要殺劉邦。
    項羽的老師見多識廣，他敏銳地發覺劉邦是在偽裝，況且他不想給項羽留下什麼隱患，所以堅持要殺掉劉邦。他請了一個人表演舞劍，企圖假裝“不小心”，一劍殺了劉邦。項羽卻遲疑了，他想：“倘若自己殺錯了好人，勢必會影響自己的名聲、信譽。”

The only thing he had going for him was that he did what he was told.

sentences.simplified: 项羽和刘邦同时往关中攻打。
sentences.traditional: 項羽和劉邦同時往關中攻打。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ hé liú bāng tóng shí wǎng guān zhōng gōng dǎ

sentences.simplified: 按照他们的约定，谁先攻打下关中，谁就是下一个皇帝。
sentences.traditional: 按照他們的約定，誰先攻打下關中，誰就是下一個皇帝。
sentences.pinyin: àn zhào tā men de yuē dìng shéi xiān gōng dǎ xià guān zhōng shéi jiù shì xià yí ge huáng dì
sentences.english: Xiang Yu and Liu Bang went to fight Guanzhong at the same time.

sentences.simplified: 可惜的是，项羽走得不太顺利，路上遇到了不少秦兵。
sentences.traditional: 可惜的是，項羽走得不太順利，路上遇到了不少秦兵。
sentences.pinyin: kě xī de shì xiàng yǔ zǒu de bú tài shùn lì lù shang yù dào le bù shǎo qín bīng
sentences.english: According to their agreement, whoever captured Guanzhong first would be the next emperor.

sentences.simplified: 他不停地打啊、打啊，回头一看，刘邦已经进了关中。
sentences.traditional: 他不停地打啊、打啊，回頭一看，劉邦已經進了關中。
sentences.pinyin: tā bù tíng de dǎ a dǎ a huí tóu yí kàn liú bāng yǐ jīng jìn le guān zhōng
sentences.english: Unfortunately, Xiang Yu’s journey was not smooth. He encountered many Qin soldiers on the way.
He kept fighting and fighting, and when he looked around, Liu Bang had already entered Guanzhong.

sentences.simplified: 项羽急了，他决定不管什么约定了，杀了刘邦，自己不就能当皇帝了吗？
sentences.traditional: 項羽急了，他決定不管什麼約定了，殺了劉邦，自己不就能當皇帝了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ jí le tā jué dìng bù guǎn shén me yuē dìng le shā le liú bāng zì jǐ bú jiù néng dāng huáng dì le ma

sentences.simplified: 项羽进到关中后，在朋友、老师的指点下，
sentences.traditional: 項羽進到關中後，在朋友、老師的指點下，
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ jìn dào guān zhōng hòu zài péng you lǎo shī de zhǐ diǎn xià
sentences.english: Xiang Yu was anxious and decided to ignore the agreement. If Liu Bang was killed, would he not become the emperor?

sentences.simplified: 在城外“鸿门”这个地方安排好了一个宴会，
sentences.traditional: 在城外“鴻門”這個地方安排好了一個宴會，
sentences.pinyin: zài chéng wài hóng mén zhè ge dì fang ān pái hǎo le yí ge yàn huì
sentences.english: After entering Guanzhong, Xiang Yu, under the guidance of his friends and teacher, ..

sentences.simplified: 准备请刘邦来吃饭，然后在那里杀了他。
sentences.traditional: 準備請劉邦來吃飯，然後在那裡殺了他。
sentences.pinyin: zhǔn bèi qǐng liú bāng lái chī fàn rán hòu zài nà lǐ shā le tā
sentences.english: .. arranged a banquet at a place outside the city called “Hongmen”.
He prepared to invite Liu Bang to dinner and then kill him there.

sentences.simplified: 项羽的人马有四十多万，刘邦的人马只有十几万。
sentences.traditional: 項羽的人馬有四十多萬，劉邦的人馬只有十幾萬。
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ de rén mǎ yǒu sì shí duō wàn liú bāng de rén mǎ zhǐ yǒu shí jǐ wàn

sentences.simplified: 经过手下的分析，刘邦从胜利的兴奋中清醒过来，
sentences.traditional: 經過手下的分析，劉邦從勝利的興奮中清醒過來，
sentences.pinyin: jīng guò shǒu xià de fēn xī liú bāng cóng shèng lì de xīng fèn zhōng qīng xǐng guò lái
sentences.english: Xiang Yu had more than 400,000 troops, while Liu Bang only had just over 100,000 troops.

sentences.simplified: 他也明白了事态严峻：
sentences.traditional: 他也明白了事態嚴峻：
sentences.pinyin: tā yě míng bai le shì tài yán jùn
sentences.english: After the analysis of his men, Liu Bang sobered up from the excitement of victory.

sentences.simplified: 一不小心，恐怕自己就会死在项羽的刀下。
sentences.traditional: 一不小心，恐怕自己就會死在項羽的刀下。
sentences.pinyin: yí bù xiǎo xīn kǒng pà zì jǐ jiù huì sǐ zài xiàng yǔ de dāo xià
sentences.english: He understood the seriousness of the situation:

sentences.simplified: 于是，他事先跟项羽的叔叔求情，装作很可怜的样子，说：
sentences.traditional: 於是，他事先跟項羽的叔叔求情，裝作很可憐的樣子，說：
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā shì xiān gēn xiàng yǔ de shū shu qiú qíng zhuāng zuò hěn kě lián de yàng zi shuō
sentences.english: If he was not careful, he was afraid that he would die under Xiang Yu’s sword.

sentences.simplified: “我进了关中，也是等着项羽，想帮你们管好这些人呢！
sentences.traditional: “我進了關中，也是等著項羽，想幫你們管好這些人呢！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ jìn le guān zhōng yě shì děng zhe xiàng yǔ xiǎng bāng nǐ men guǎn hǎo zhè xiē rén ne
sentences.english: So he pleaded with Xiang Yu’s uncle beforehand, pretending to be pitiful and saying, ..

sentences.simplified: 我没有想当皇帝，但项羽却想杀我。
sentences.traditional: 我沒有想當皇帝，但項羽卻想殺我。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ méi yǒu xiǎng dāng huáng dì dàn xiàng yǔ què xiǎng shā wǒ
sentences.english: .. “I went into Guanzhong and waited for Xiang Yu. I wanted to help you take care of these people!

sentences.simplified: 请您帮我求求情，让项羽不要杀我。”
sentences.traditional: 請您幫我求求情，讓項羽不要殺我。”
sentences.pinyin: qǐng nín bāng wǒ qiú qiú qíng ràng xiàng yǔ bú yào shā wǒ
sentences.english: I don’t want to be the emperor, but Xiang Yu wants to kill me.
Please plead for mercy for me and ask Xiang Yu not to kill me.”

sentences.simplified: 刘邦的办法很有用，项羽的叔叔听了刘邦的话，
sentences.traditional: 劉邦的辦法很有用，項羽的叔叔聽了劉邦的話，
sentences.pinyin: liú bāng de bàn fǎ hěn yǒu yòng xiàng yǔ de shū shu tīng le liú bāng de huà

sentences.simplified: 认为刘邦是个好人，帮他劝说了项羽。
sentences.traditional: 認為劉邦是個好人，幫他勸說了項羽。
sentences.pinyin: rèn wéi liú bāng shì ge hǎo rén bāng tā quàn shuō le xiàng yǔ
sentences.english: Liu Bang’s method worked. Xiang Yu’s uncle listened to Liu Bang.
He thought that Liu Bang was a good man and helped him to persuade Xiang Yu.

sentences.simplified: 到了“鸿门宴”那天，刘邦硬着头皮应邀前来，还郑重地向项羽道歉。
sentences.traditional: 到了“鴻門宴”那天，劉邦硬著頭皮應邀前來，還鄭重地向項羽道歉。
sentences.pinyin: dào le hóng mén yàn nà tiān liú bāng yìng zhe tóu pí yìng yāo qián lái hái zhèng zhòng de xiàng xiàng yǔ dào qiàn

sentences.simplified: 这让项羽觉得自己误会了刘邦，就开始犹豫要不要杀刘邦。
sentences.traditional: 這讓項羽覺得自己誤會了劉邦，就開始猶豫要不要殺劉邦。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ràng xiàng yǔ jué de zì jǐ wù huì le liú bāng jiù kāi shǐ yóu yù yào bú yào shā liú bāng
sentences.english: On the day of the “Hongmen banquet”, Liu Bang braced himself and came as invited. He also solemnly apologized to Xiang Yu.
This made Xiang Yu think that he had misunderstood Liu Bang, and he began to hesitate whether or not to kill Liu Bang.

sentences.simplified: 项羽的老师见多识广，他敏锐地发觉刘邦是在伪装，
sentences.traditional: 項羽的老師見多識廣，他敏銳地發覺劉邦是在偽裝，
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ de lǎo shī jiàn duō shí guǎng tā mǐn ruì de fā jué liú bāng shì zài wěi zhuāng

sentences.simplified: 况且他不想给项羽留下什么隐患，所以坚持要杀掉刘邦。
sentences.traditional: 況且他不想給項羽留下什麼隱患，所以堅持要殺掉劉邦。
sentences.pinyin: kuàng qiě tā bù xiǎng gěi xiàng yǔ liú xià shén me yǐn huàn suǒ yǐ jiān chí yào shā diào liú bāng
sentences.english: Xiang Yu’s teacher was experienced and knowledgeable, and he was keenly aware that Liu Bang was pretending.

sentences.simplified: 他请了一个人表演舞剑，企图假装“不小心”，一剑杀了刘邦。
sentences.traditional: 他請了一個人表演舞劍，企圖假裝“不小心”，一劍殺了劉邦。
sentences.pinyin: tā qǐng le yí ge rén biǎo yǎn wǔ jiàn qǐ tú jiǎ zhuāng bù xiǎo xīn yí jiàn shā le liú bāng
sentences.english: Moreover, he didn’t want to leave any hidden dangers for Xiang Yu, so he persisted in waiting to kill Liu Bang.

sentences.simplified: 项羽却迟疑了，他想：“倘若自己杀错了好人，势必会影响自己的名声、信誉。”
sentences.traditional: 項羽卻遲疑了，他想：“倘若自己殺錯了好人，勢必會影響自己的名聲、信譽。”
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ què chí yí le tā xiǎng tǎng ruò zì jǐ shā cuò le hǎo rén shì bì huì yǐng xiǎng zì jǐ de míng shēng xìn yù
sentences.english: He hired a man to perform a sword dance in an attempt to “accidentally” kill Liu Bang.
But Xiang Yu hesitated. He thought, “If I mistakenly kill a good person, it will definitely affect my reputation and prestige.”

sentences.simplified: 这时，项羽的叔叔不想刘邦死，他也起来舞剑，
sentences.traditional: 這時，項羽的叔叔不想劉邦死，他也起來舞劍，
sentences.pinyin: zhè shí xiàng yǔ de shū shu bù xiǎng liú bāng sǐ tā yě qǐ lái wǔ jiàn

sentences.simplified: 想方设法保护了刘邦，因此项羽的老师就没有机会杀人了。
sentences.traditional: 想方設法保護了劉邦，因此項羽的老師就沒有機會殺人了。
sentences.pinyin: xiǎng fāng shè fǎ bǎo hù le liú bāng yīn cǐ xiàng yǔ de lǎo shī jiù méi yǒu jī huì shā rén le
sentences.english: At this moment, Xiang Yu’s uncle didn’t want Liu Bang to die, so he also got up to perform a sword dance.
He thought up every possible method to protect Liu Bang so Xiang Yu’s teacher didn’t have a chance to kill him.

sentences.simplified: 过了一会儿，刘邦借口“上厕所”，从后门溜走，
sentences.traditional: 過了一會兒，劉邦借口“上廁所”，從後門溜走，
sentences.pinyin: guò le yí huì'r liú bāng jiè kǒu shàng cè suǒ cóng hòu mén liū zǒu

sentences.simplified: 动身回自己的领地了。
sentences.traditional: 動身回自己的領地了。
sentences.pinyin: dòng shēn huí zì jǐ de lǐng dì le
sentences.english: After a while, Liu Bang slipped out through the back door on the pretext of “going to the toilet”, ..

sentences.simplified: 他从这次致命的宴会中成功逃脱，也争取到了继续发展势力的机会。
sentences.traditional: 他從這次致命的宴會中成功逃脫，也爭取到了繼續發展勢力的機會。
sentences.pinyin: tā cóng zhè cì zhì mìng de yàn huì zhōng chéng gōng táo tuō yě zhēng qǔ dào le jì xù fā zhǎn shì li de jī huì
sentences.english: .. and returned to his own territory.
He managed to escape from this fatal banquet and also won the opportunity to continue to develop his power.

sentences.simplified: 项羽的老师对此非常恼火，大骂项羽：
sentences.traditional: 項羽的老師對此非常惱火，大罵項羽：
sentences.pinyin: xiàng yǔ de lǎo shī duì cǐ fēi cháng nǎo huǒ dà mà xiàng yǔ

sentences.simplified: “这小子，真不该和他一起做事！
sentences.traditional: “這小子，真不該和他一起做事！
sentences.pinyin: zhè xiǎo zi zhēn bù gāi hé tā yì qǐ zuò shì
sentences.english: Xiang Yu’s teacher was very angry by this and loudly cursed Xiang Yu:

sentences.simplified: 我敢说，最后当上皇帝的一定是刘邦，我们都会死在他手里！”
sentences.traditional: 我敢說，最後當上皇帝的一定是劉邦，我們都會死在他手裡！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ gǎn shuō zuì hòu dāng shang huáng dì de yí dìng shì liú bāng wǒ men dōu huì sǐ zài tā shǒu lǐ
sentences.english: “This joker. I really shouldn’t have anything to do with him!
I dare say it will be Liu Bang who becomes emperor in the end, and we will all die by his hand!”

sentences.simplified: 到底项羽老师的预言有没有成真呢？请听下回分解。
sentences.traditional: 到底項羽老師的預言有沒有成真呢？請聽下回分解。
sentences.pinyin: dào dǐ xiàng yǔ lǎo shī de yù yán yǒu méi yǒu chéng zhēn ne qǐng tīng xià huí fēn jiě

sentences.english: Did the prophecy of Xiang Yu’s teacher come true after all? Listen to the next part to find out.

sentences.simplified: “鸿门宴”这个故事非常有名。
sentences.traditional: “鴻門宴”這個故事非常有名。
sentences.pinyin: hóng mén yàn zhè ge gù shi fēi cháng yǒu míng

sentences.simplified: 现在，我们仍旧会把这种危险的、不怀好意的邀请称为“鸿门宴”。
sentences.traditional: 現在，我們仍舊會把這種危險的、不懷好意的邀請稱為“鴻門宴”。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn zài wǒ men réng jiù huì bǎ zhè zhǒng wēi xiǎn de bù huái hǎo yì de yāo qǐng chēng wéi hóng mén yàn
sentences.english: The story of the “Hongmen banquet” is very famous.

sentences.simplified: 譬如说：我和他一直都是竞争对手，今天他突然要请我吃饭，
sentences.traditional: 譬如說：我和他一直都是競爭對手，今天他突然要請我吃飯，
sentences.pinyin: pì rú shuō wǒ hé tā yì zhí dōu shì jìng zhēng duì shǒu jīn tiān tā tū rán yào qǐng wǒ chī fàn
sentences.english: To this day, we still refer to dangerous invitations with malicious intentions as a “Hongmen banquet”.

sentences.simplified: 我看这一定是“鸿门宴”！
sentences.traditional: 我看這一定是“鴻門宴”！
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn zhè yí dìng shì hóng mén yàn
sentences.english: For example, he and I have always been competitors, and today he suddenly wants to invite me to dinner.

sentence_translations: Chu-Han Contention
Why are most people in China “Han”?
Prior to the Qin Dynasty, the territory of China had many small states.
Each of these was self-reliant, and therefore, there was no unified nationality.
Subsequently, although the Qin Dynasty merged all of these small states, the Qin Dynasty only existed for 14 years.
So when the Qin Dynasty fell, people from around the country still did not feel that they were the same people.
Then came the Han Dynasty.
After the Han Dynasty was established, the country became strong and prosperous. That lasted for over 400 years.
Gradually, everyone considered themselves to be “Han Chinese” and the same ethnic group—the “Han”.
Today, the “Han” population is as high as 1.2 billion.
The incredible Han Dynasty’s birth was not a smooth affair.
At the end of the Qin Dynasty, the emperor forced the people to become soldiers, to build houses for him, and to build the Great Wall.
This caused many people to die of hunger and exhaustion.
So people everywhere rose up and revolted, wanting to become emperor themselves.
In order to make their claims sound reasonable, some of those who revolted said, ..
.. “Are those who are emperors and generals chosen by heaven? They can be emperors and generals, so I can also try.”
Some said, “My mother dreamed of a white dragon when she gave birth to me, so I am the emperor chosen by heaven.”
Others said, “My ancestors were emperors, so I am nobility” …
There were many people who wanted to be emperor, but there could only be one with that position.
So these people made a pact: “Whoever reaches the emperor’s home,  Guanzhong, first will be the next emperor!”
The two most famous of these people were Xiang Yu and Liu Bang.
Xiang Yu was a young man of noble status who was particularly good at fighting.
He had a very large number of supporters. His only flaw was that he was stubborn.
Although Liu Bang always said he was a child of a white dragon, unlike Xiang Yu, he was not the real deal.
Liu Bang’s family was ordinary, and he was already in his forties.
The only thing he had going for him was that he did what he was told.
Xiang Yu and Liu Bang went to fight Guanzhong at the same time.
According to their agreement, whoever captured Guanzhong first would be the next emperor.
Unfortunately, Xiang Yu’s journey was not smooth. He encountered many Qin soldiers on the way.
He kept fighting and fighting, and when he looked around, Liu Bang had already entered Guanzhong.
Xiang Yu was anxious and decided to ignore the agreement. If Liu Bang was killed, would he not become the emperor?
After entering Guanzhong, Xiang Yu, under the guidance of his friends and teacher, ..
.. arranged a banquet at a place outside the city called “Hongmen”.
He prepared to invite Liu Bang to dinner and then kill him there.
Xiang Yu had more than 400,000 troops, while Liu Bang only had just over 100,000 troops.
After the analysis of his men, Liu Bang sobered up from the excitement of victory.
He understood the seriousness of the situation:
If he was not careful, he was afraid that he would die under Xiang Yu’s sword.
So he pleaded with Xiang Yu’s uncle beforehand, pretending to be pitiful and saying, ..
.. “I went into Guanzhong and waited for Xiang Yu. I wanted to help you take care of these people!
I don’t want to be the emperor, but Xiang Yu wants to kill me.
Please plead for mercy for me and ask Xiang Yu not to kill me.”
Liu Bang’s method worked. Xiang Yu’s uncle listened to Liu Bang.
He thought that Liu Bang was a good man and helped him to persuade Xiang Yu.
On the day of the “Hongmen banquet”, Liu Bang braced himself and came as invited. He also solemnly apologized to Xiang Yu.
This made Xiang Yu think that he had misunderstood Liu Bang, and he began to hesitate whether or not to kill Liu Bang.
Xiang Yu’s teacher was experienced and knowledgeable, and he was keenly aware that Liu Bang was pretending.
Moreover, he didn’t want to leave any hidden dangers for Xiang Yu, so he persisted in waiting to kill Liu Bang.
He hired a man to perform a sword dance in an attempt to “accidentally” kill Liu Bang.
But Xiang Yu hesitated. He thought, “If I mistakenly kill a good person, it will definitely affect my reputation and prestige.”
At this moment, Xiang Yu’s uncle didn’t want Liu Bang to die, so he also got up to perform a sword dance.
He thought up every possible method to protect Liu Bang so Xiang Yu’s teacher didn’t have a chance to kill him.
After a while, Liu Bang slipped out through the back door on the pretext of “going to the toilet”, ..
.. and returned to his own territory.
He managed to escape from this fatal banquet and also won the opportunity to continue to develop his power.
Xiang Yu’s teacher was very angry by this and loudly cursed Xiang Yu:
“This joker. I really shouldn’t have anything to do with him!
I dare say it will be Liu Bang who becomes emperor in the end, and we will all die by his hand!”
